title: Outcome API run_task request (v1)
description: Enforced by memory_fabric.outcome_typed.api.validate_request with the standard library. Authority-bearing and executable fields are refused; effects are host-registered and chosen by name.

errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request does not match the schema; nothing ran.
errors.UNKNOWN_TASK: No task with this id has run through this API.
errors.NOT_RUN: The operation needs a task that has run; this one has not.
errors.NON_REPLAYABLE: The recorded task cannot be resumed: its trace is incomplete.
errors.BLOCKED: The task cannot be resumed: its stop is not recoverable by re-running.
errors.UNDECIDABLE: Whether the effect happened is unknown; reconcile before anything else.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The task used its whole budget; the host must decide to extend it.

examples.objective: set the actuator to the current instrument-A reading
